# Pinned companion oracle

`oracle.json` is a normalized test-only extract of the specification results
produced from `laubeing-droid/legal-math-modeling` commit
`a3a015941f75091c87d57aa956e712f1546dd7d4`.

Source: https://github.com/laubeing-droid/legal-math-modeling
License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Changes: local paths, implementation objects, and non-comparable report fields
were removed; the ten B02 specification outcomes were normalized as JSON.
